context_requirements: Neuronal lineage or functional GABA-A receptor expression
Blood-brain barrier penetration for CNS effects
falsifiers: Consistent, reproducible changes in landmark gene expression at 6 h or 24 h in any of the nine cell lines
Enrichment of GABA receptor subunit genes among changed landmark genes

evidence.supports: Sedative drugs reduce neurogenesis in developing brain but do not cause apoptosis in proliferating cells
Agarwood essential oil sedative effects are mediated through GABA-A receptors
Eudesmin sedative effects involve GABAergic mechanisms with increased GABA and GAD65 expression
Sedative/anesthetic drugs can trigger neuroapoptosis in developing brain, but this is not expected in the tested cell lines
